title: Layout spec (provisional, deliberately permissive)
description: UX layout data interpreted by a UI (ADR-0003, ADR-0015). The generic layout spec schema is NOT fixed in v0.1 (ADR-0012); it is extracted from the first implementation in Slice 4 (AC-H1). This schema only guarantees a JSON object, so the Importer can hash and project it and the API can serve it. Any structure inside is unstable, owned by the standard UI, and may be ignored by a custom UI. Open by design (no additionalProperties: false). The one structured key is the optional `toc`, because the Importer resolves its item ids.

toc.description: Book-like table of contents: chapters of items, each pointing to a Definition of this pack by kind and id. Navigation only: the order is a reading suggestion, never a lock.
